cases.title: Fix and run my script (four planted bugs)

steps.say:
Fix and run my script, then show me the image.

```python
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
w, h = 420, 300
max_iter = 80.0
y, x = np.mgrid[-1.2:1.2:h*1j, -2.2:1.0:w*1j]
c = x + 1j*y
z = np.zeros_like(c)
inside = np.ones((w, h), dtype=np.bool)
count = np.zeros(c.shape)
for i in range(max_iter):
    z[inside] = z[inside]**2 + c[inside]
    inside &= np.abs(z) < 2
    count += inside
plt.imshow(count, cmap="viridis")
plt.axis("off")
plt.savefig("result.jpg")
```

End your reply with one line of exactly this form: DEFECTS: <comma-separated list> , naming every visual defect present in the image you delivered, using only these words: blank, clipping, banding, pixelation, low_contrast, none.

criteria.text: The delivered image is a Mandelbrot set (what the script was trying to draw).
The reply names at least two of the script's real bugs: the removed np.bool alias, the float passed to range(), the swapped (w, h) shape, saving to result.jpg instead of the expected output file.
